name: d121_32order
notes: The design-121 32-order Dammann fan through the staged pipeline, end to end: the DOE's own order table -> 32 independent traced chains to the fine-retrace exit -> one common carrier -> one leg plan -> 32 Bluestein zooms. ray_subsample=1 is this pipeline's default and is the configuration PROBE_CHAIN_LADDER_PISTON S2.4 recommends for an aggregating consumer: rs=4 throws away 6.5e-03 of the aperture power, 160x the campaign's 4e-05 energy bar, and no affordable grid refinement recovers it as cheaply. n_fine_cap=8192 is the affordable grid of record (ADJUDICATION_NFC_8192); the pre-flight PROVES the RAM clamp cannot bind and the runner asserts the grid it got. AGGREGATE GRID, corrected 2026-08-17 (audit S11 item 3): dx_common=1.0 um on n_common=12288. The shipped 1.2292 um / 8192 pair was written before the band-aware Nyquist guard of 0f46efb and cannot complete on the shipped library: the guard's binding pitch over these 32 chains is 1.108184 um (measured; worst beam (-4,-2), 'reconstruct' term), so 1.2292 um scores a margin of 0.9015 and is REFUSED under on_nyquist='error'. 1.0 um scores 1.1082. n_common has to grow with it: containment needs a 4.5776 mm half-window (worst |chief ray| 1.9351 mm plus its 2.6425 mm support), which 8192 x 1.0 um (4.096 mm) does NOT reach and 12288 x 1.0 um (6.144 mm) clears by 1.566 mm -- so no choice of dx alone fixes this spec. Both numbers are the exp29 run of record's own: that run aggregated at exactly this pitch and grid and recorded worst Nyquist margin 1.1081836 and worst containment +1.5664 mm. Witness: specs/_measured_nyquist.json, re-evaluated against the live guard by tests/unit/test_pipeline_spec_guard_validity.py. capture_reference_tile keeps each chain's own shipped-path tile, which is what the per-frame comparison is scored against. LEG MODE: 'crop' is the like-for-like variant against the shipped per-order path and is what the run of record used. BUILD_PIPELINE_2026_08_11 S6.4 then MEASURED that at 32 orders the 4.74 mm crop cuts the fan's own neighbours mid-aperture and their diffraction lands in the frame: worst |P/P_shipped - 1| = 2.384e-04 against the campaign's 4e-05 bar, with every ratio ABOVE 1. On the same summed field and the same frames the 'full' leg -- the architecture as specified, which truncates nothing -- reads 2.641e-05 and holds every bar. Set leg.mode='full' for a FILLED fan; 'crop' is right only for a sparse subset.
